_comment: BOUNDARY RULES: Translate interface chrome (titles, headings, column headers, button labels, placeholders, captions, empty/error states, severity labels, rule labels). NEVER translate data: work descriptions, state/district/constituency names, MP names, agency names, vendor names, work IDs, case IDs, rule IDs, hashes, emails. Keep digits Latin.

landing.title: NIGRANI
landing.attribution: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation · Government of India
landing.searchPlaceholder: Search by Case ID, Work ID, District, or MP…
landing.caveat: Measured on twelve published exports from the MPLADS national portal. All figures verified by reproducible SHA-256 audit runs.
landing.emblemAlt: Government of India / Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation Emblem
landing.section1Title: Anomalies identified across the national corpus
landing.section1Subtitle: Deterministic algorithmic scoring against published MoSPI guidelines.
landing.card1Text: Normalises disparate state-level datasets, vendor invoices, and work sanctions across 31 states and UTs into a unified verifiable format.
landing.card2Text: Evaluates every work item against codified scheme rules: cost-splitting thresholds, duplicate descriptions, stalled disbursements, and agency concentration.
landing.card3Text: Generates immutable cryptographic hashes and clear citation memos for every identified anomaly. Officers inspect the raw evidence before taking action.
landing.previewSubtitle: Cases flagged for priority review by District Authorities and State Nodal Officers.
landing.findingHeading: What we found before we built
landing.findingVariance: Every matched work where both numbers are published has zero variance.
landing.findingP1: Across every work where both figures are published, the recommended amount and the sanctioned amount are the same number. Not close — identical.
landing.findingP2: The portal publishes no revised estimate, so cost overrun cannot be detected from public MPLADS data at all.
landing.findingP3: MPLADS data is financially flat and temporally rich. The signal is in time and repetition — and that is what NIGRANI reads.
landing.authoritiesLede: Each sees only what their office is responsible for. Scoping is enforced in the database query, not in the interface.
landing.roleDescMinistry: National risk map, state league table, and a reporting-gap report on MoSPI’s own data format.
landing.roleDescState: District comparison and utilisation trend, so slow districts surface before financial year-end.
landing.roleDescDistrict: A ranked, evidence-ordered queue that replaces rotation-based inspection with evidence triage.
landing.roleDescMember: Own account utilisation and stalled recommendations, in a read-only audit view.
landing.scoreCard1Desc: The system names which hop the money stalled at, comparing signed variance against measured tolerances.
landing.scoreCard2Desc: Identifies which administrative or execution stage lost the time, so criticism lands on the responsible desk.
landing.scoreCard3Desc: Ten thresholds in YAML, each carrying the count of works it fires on. The Ministry edits them live with versioning.
landing.scoreCard4Desc: A rule with no reading is reported as not published, never as passed. Mean signal coverage today is 58.47%.
landing.scoreCard5Desc: Opens candidate work IDs side by side for manual review. 447 clusters found across agencies.
landing.scoreCard6Desc: 84,666 hash-chained events. A score re-derives months later against the stored rulebook snapshot in force that day.
landing.wallHeading: Four detection tiers, and the wall between them
landing.tier1Desc: 10 domain rules evaluating fund gaps, execution delays, and missing milestones.
landing.tier2Desc: Syntactic & semantic clustering with cited candidate works.
landing.tier3Desc: Isolation forest and gradient-boosted delay forecast.
landing.wallFormula1: score = Σ w(fired rules) + corroboration bonus, capped at 100
landing.wallIntegrity: An automated test walks the import graph and fails the build if the scoring engine ever imports the machine-learning package. The number in the corner cannot come from a model.
landing.gap1Desc: 70,647 skips across 23,549 works. Linking expenditure increases mean coverage from 58.47% to 88.91%.
landing.gap2Desc: 14,104 skips. Unrecorded physical progress certificates stall certification verification.
landing.gap3Desc: 7 fields published as zero rather than omitting or explaining unmeasured hops.

datagap.title: Data-gap recommendation report
datagap.lede: Ablation analysis demonstrating that linking public expenditure exports raises mean signal coverage from 58.47% to 88.91%.
datagap.impactProjCaption: Comparing current evaluated rule weight against potential coverage when missing relational keys are linked in MoSPI portal exports.
datagap.rankedGapsCaption: Specific reporting deficiencies identified in public MPLADS datasets, ordered by coverage loss magnitude.
datagap.formalStatementP1: 1. Retain Relational Integrity Across Exports: Currently, the public expenditure exports lack the uniform work identification keys present in work master datasets. Introducing a standardized composite key (Work ID + District ID) across financial ledgers will immediately recover up to 30.44 percentage points of audit signal without requiring modifications to state accounting systems.
datagap.formalStatementP2: 2. Distinguish Between Unrecorded and True Zero: Distinguishing between genuinely unspent balances and unrecorded milestone data is critical. Reporting nulls as explicit zero figures creates false-positive anomalies in deterministic rule matching. We recommend enforcing schema validation at portal ingestion to distinguish missing records from numeric zero balances.
